name: Kamlesh Pattni
roles: Central figure in the 'Gold Mafia' investigation
Key figure in the Kenyan Goldenberg scandal
connection_to_money_laundering: Filmed in the 'Gold Mafia' documentary describing how he could move large amounts of gold and launder money through Zimbabwe. Previously implicated in the 1990s Goldenberg scandal in Kenya involving alleged smuggling of gold and diamonds.
connection_to_political_figures: Claimed to use political connections to facilitate gold smuggling, including alleged ties to the Zimbabwean presidency. In Kenya, operated in league with prominent politicians and government officials during the Goldenberg scandal.
